name: switch/debugbar
description: Blazing fast, zero-overhead, responsive developer debug bar for the Switch Framework

suggest.switch/database: To capture and analyze SQL queries, N+1 detection, and timings
suggest.switch/router: To inspect matched routes, controllers, and middleware
suggest.switch/view: To track rendered views, partials, and view parameters
suggest.switch/session: To inspect active session data and flash messages
suggest.switch/foundation: To inspect authentication state and cache operations
